# Kaggle Competitions

> Kaggle portfolio: competition solutions with full write-ups, Kaggle Learn
> certificates and earned badges. Each folder records the approach taken,
> the constraint that shaped it, and where it ran out. Notebooks Expert.
> Active, with competitions added as they are entered.

Author: Amey Thakur, ORCID 0000-0001-5644-1575
Licence: CC BY 4.0, attribution required
Repository created: 6 March 2026
